messages:
erin: Spontaneous idea  midweek happy hour + tiny game swap at The Corner Bar tonight? 6:00pm-ish. quick, low-key. who wants in? :beers: :game_die:

sam: i'm down if we can get a table. i can bring a travel chess set and some snacks.

julio: might be late (team sync), but can join at ~7pm. can we vote on start time?

tara: love this. i'll check with The Corner Bar if a small table is free and reserve for 6:15.

lunchbot: Poll: "Start time tonight" options: 6:00, 6:30, 7:00  vote with :one: :two: :three:. (poll id 9812)

sam: voted :one: (6:00)

julio: voted :three: (7:00)

 erin: @julio ok no problem  casual arrive times fine. tara if you can reserve that would be awesome.

tara: reserved table for 6 under "Redwood" at The Corner Bar (patio if dry). max 6.

sam: i'll bring snacks + napkins. anyone want to chip in $10 for runner drinks/cover? i can Venmo later.

erin: I'll throw $10 your way. also remote folks can dial in on my laptop if they want to hang out virtually.

julio: i'll swing by after sync and bring a small pack of cards.

lunchbot: Reminder set: "Corner Bar happy hour" 2026-03-18 17:00 (local)

tara: If plans change post here. see you later :wave:"
